es: Describir cifras y tendencias de un gráfico con verbos de cambio, adverbios de intensidad y aproximaciones (rose sharply, a steady rise, fluctuate, plummet, account for, just under) y valorar lo que los datos permiten afirmar.

teaching.en: Bus use rose sharply in March, from roughly 2,000 to 3,500 passengers, before it began to level off at the end of spring.
teaching.es: El uso del autobús subió bruscamente en marzo, de unos 2.000 a 3.500 pasajeros, antes de empezar a estabilizarse a finales de primavera.
teaching.explanationEs: Rose sharply: verbo de subida + adverbio de intensidad; from… to… da el punto de partida y de llegada; level off = dejar de subir y estabilizarse.
segments: Bus use rose sharply in March, from roughly 2,000 to 3,500 passengers,
before it began to level off at the end of spring.
teaching.audioText: Bus use rose sharply in March, from roughly 2,000 to 3,500 passengers, before it began to level off at the end of spring.

teaching.en: The number of cyclists fell slightly between May and June, although the figure for the whole year was still higher than last year.
teaching.es: El número de ciclistas bajó ligeramente entre mayo y junio, aunque la cifra de todo el año seguía siendo mayor que la del año pasado.
teaching.explanationEs: Slightly describe un cambio pequeño; figure es la cifra o dato numérico; although introduce un contraste.
segments: The number of cyclists fell slightly between May and June, although the
figure for the whole year was still higher than last year.
teaching.audioText: The number of cyclists fell slightly between May and June, although the figure for the whole year was still higher than last year.

teaching.en: Train use grew gradually over the year, and there was a steady rise in tram passengers, from 900 to just over 1,200.
teaching.es: El uso del tren creció poco a poco durante el año, y hubo una subida constante de pasajeros de tranvía, de 900 a algo más de 1.200.
teaching.explanationEs: Gradually: cambio lento; a steady rise: sustantivo de tendencia + adjetivo; just over = algo más de.
segments: Train use grew gradually over the year, and there was a
steady rise in tram passengers, from 900 to just over 1,200.
teaching.audioText: Train use grew gradually over the year, and there was a steady rise in tram passengers, from 900 to just over 1,200.

teaching.en: Taxi use tends to fluctuate during the summer, and it can plummet when prices go up by almost twenty percent.
teaching.es: El uso del taxi tiende a fluctuar durante el verano y puede caer en picado cuando los precios suben casi un veinte por ciento.
teaching.explanationEs: Fluctuate: sube y baja sin rumbo claro; plummet: caída muy brusca; by + cifra indica cuánto cambia algo.
segments: Taxi use tends to fluctuate during the summer, and it
can plummet when prices go up by almost twenty percent.
teaching.audioText: Taxi use tends to fluctuate during the summer, and it can plummet when prices go up by almost twenty percent.

teaching.en: Commuters account for roughly forty percent of all passengers, while tourists account for only about ten percent.
teaching.es: Los viajeros habituales representan aproximadamente el cuarenta por ciento de los pasajeros, mientras que los turistas solo representan un diez por ciento.
teaching.explanationEs: Account for + porcentaje: la parte que un grupo representa del total; roughly y about aproximan.
segments: Commuters account for roughly forty percent of all passengers,
while tourists account for only about ten percent.
teaching.audioText: Commuters account for roughly forty percent of all passengers, while tourists account for only about ten percent.

teaching.en: The figure for taxis should remain steady at around 500 a day, unless the drop in tourist numbers continues.
teaching.es: La cifra de taxis debería mantenerse estable en torno a 500 al día, a menos que continúe la caída del número de turistas.
teaching.explanationEs: Remain steady: no cambia; drop es la caída como sustantivo y va seguida de in o of + lo que se mide.
segments: The figure for taxis should remain steady at around 500
a day, unless the drop in tourist numbers continues.
teaching.audioText: The figure for taxis should remain steady at around 500 a day, unless the drop in tourist numbers continues.

prompt.es: Elige la descripción más precisa de los datos de ciclismo.

choices.text: Cycling rose sharply in May, then remained steady in June.
Cycling rose gradually from April to June, by roughly ten percent.
Cycling rose sharply in May, then dropped slightly in June.

feedback.es: De abril a mayo la cifra se cuadruplica (cambio brusco) y de mayo a junio casi no cambia (410 frente a 400): se mantiene estable.

hint.es: Compara mayo con abril y luego junio con mayo: primero un cambio grande, después casi ninguno.

origin.text: A council report gives the monthly cycling figures: 100 riders in April, 400 in May and 410 in June.

prompt.es: Completa: «El uso del taxi tendía a fluctuar de una semana a otra.»

feedback.es: Fluctuate describe una cifra que sube y baja sin una dirección clara; por eso no se habla de tendencia.

hint.es: Verbo para algo que sube y baja sin rumbo fijo.

origin.text: Taxi use was irregular last summer. It tended to ___ from week to week, and then it fell sharply in October.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El uso del tranvía subió poco a poco de novecientos a unos mil doscientos.»

answer.text: Tram use rose gradually from nine hundred to roughly twelve hundred

feedback.es: Sujeto + verbo de cambio + adverbio + from… to…: roughly aproxima la cifra de llegada.

hint.es: Empieza con el sujeto Tram use y deja from… to… para el final.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige a qué atribuye la oradora la subida del autobús.

choices.text: A sharp increase in the number of commuters.
A cut in fares introduced by the council.
The way train use grew gradually that year.

feedback.es: La oradora dice que el autobús subió bruscamente en marzo «after the council cut fares»: la causa es el recorte de tarifas, no el aumento de viajeros ni el tren.

origin.audio: In her presentation, the student explained that bus use had risen sharply in March, from two thousand to three and a half thousand passengers, after the council cut fares. Train use, by contrast, grew gradually over the whole year, while the figure for taxis remained steady at around five hundred a day. She pointed out that commuters account for roughly forty percent of all passengers, but she added that the data came from a single week, so she advised the audience to be careful with the trends.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada verbo o expresión con su significado al describir datos.

pairs.es: subir y bajar sin rumbo fijo

feedback.es: Cada expresión describe un comportamiento distinto de las cifras: irregular, caída brusca, proporción del total o estabilidad.

pairs.es: subir y bajar sin rumbo fijo

prompt.es: Completa: «Algo menos de la mitad de los encuestados usa el autobús.»

feedback.es: 98 de 200 es el 49 %: una aproximación por debajo de la mitad se dice just under (o nearly) half.

origin.text: The survey covered 200 people. Of these, 98 said they take the bus, so ___ half of the respondents are regular passengers.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que describe con más precisión los datos del museo.

choices.text: Numbers stayed steady over the summer, then fell slightly in September.
Numbers rose sharply over the summer, then plummeted in September.
Numbers stayed steady over the summer, then plummeted in September.

feedback.es: De junio a agosto la cifra casi no cambia (estable) y en septiembre baja de 1.010 a 600: una caída brusca, no ligera, después de un verano sin subida fuerte.

origin.text: Museum visitors: 1,000 in June, 1,000 in July, 1,010 in August and 600 in September, once the school holidays had ended.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué le preocupa realmente a la autora del informe.

choices.text: That sales failed to recover in March as usual.
That sales fell by a third at the start of the year.
That sales fell further in March than in January.

feedback.es: La caída de enero es normal; lo que la inquieta es que la cifra de marzo apenas se mueva, señal de que no hay la recuperación habitual.

origin.audio: In her report, the author writes that sales plummeted by a third in January, but she adds that this is hardly surprising, since the same drop happens after every holiday season. What worries her more is the figure for March, which has hardly moved, because it suggests that the usual recovery has not happened this year.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los estudiantes representan aproximadamente un tercio de las respuestas.»

feedback.es: Account for + fracción o porcentaje expresa la parte que un grupo representa del total.

origin.text: The survey asked 400 people how they travel to work. Students ___ for roughly a third of the answers, while retired people made up only about one in ten.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La cifra del tranvía se mantuvo estable en torno a 900 todo el año.»

answer.text: The tram figure remained steady at around nine hundred all year

feedback.es: Remained steady describe una cifra que no cambia; at around + cifra da el nivel al que se mantuvo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué quiere dar a entender el orador con este comentario sobre las ventas?

choices.text: That the rise shows the online strategy is working well.
That the rise matters less than it first seems.
That online sales will keep growing at the same pace.

feedback.es: Tras una caída brusca, una subida del 10 % solo recupera lo perdido: el orador relativiza el dato positivo.

origin.text: From the talk: “Online sales rose by about ten percent, which sounds good. However, the figure for the previous year had plummeted, so this year's rise mostly restores what was lost.”

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué describe mejor la evolución después de diciembre.

choices.text: A steady climb that continued through the whole winter.
A sharp jump followed by a slow fall back to normal.
Small ups and downs at a somewhat higher level.

feedback.es: Tras la ligera subida de diciembre la cifra oscila entre 450 y 500: sube y baja un poco, a un nivel algo superior al inicial.

origin.audio: The figure for museum visitors was steady at around four hundred a week, but it rose slightly in December and then fluctuated between four hundred and fifty and five hundred for the rest of the winter.

prompt.es: Completa las dos frases con el adverbio y el verbo adecuados.

feedback.es: Cuadruplicar una cifra exige un adverbio de cambio fuerte, y una cifra que no varía se describe con remained steady.

sentences: Sales rose ___ in March, from 100 to 400 units.
The price level ___ steady at around five percent all year.
